capabilities: Open, edit and save .usheet spreadsheets in Obsidian
Edit .ubase relational tables and their records
Create missing single-select options from the record editor
Keep cell formatting, formulas, multiple sheets and row/column sizes
Remember active sheet, scroll position and zoom per file
disambiguation: Not an Excel editor; it works only with Univer's own .usheet and .ubase formats, as Excel import/export is intentionally not included.
extras: Bundles @univerjs-pro packages covered by a separate commercial DreamNum license, not Apache-2.0; runs in evaluation mode until a license is added in settings. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit spreadsheet-style files or relational table records natively.

relations.evidence: Obsidian plugin for Univer spreadsheets and relational tables, powered by Univer 1.2.0

summary: Spreadsheet and relational-table editor that opens, edits and saves Univer .usheet and .ubase files inside Obsidian.
